ops.title: Lexicon parity: Rust udpipe vs spaCy divergence
ops.description: tests/test_lexicon_parity.py::test_rust_filter_decisions_match_spacy fails locally on the string '<local-command-stdout>Login successful</local-command-stdout>' when the sentiment extra and spaCy en_core_web_sm are installed. Rust udpipe-lexicon filter decision diverges from spaCy. CI stays green only because the model is absent there (test self-skips). Pre-existing before the 2026-07-10 quality sweep; may be local model-version drift (afinn/spaCy/udpipe). Investigation agent dispatched in-session; findings to be appended.

ops.text: test_rust_filter_decisions_match_spacy passes with sentiment extra + en_core_web_sm installed, or divergence documented + fixture re-pinned
